painpoints.text: A broad `sed` over `automation_scheduler.rs` matching `Some("default".to_string()),$` collaterally rewrote three unrelated test fixtures, causing a confusing FK failure in automation create before I noticed (run 01M2NP2W92HHF3QAH17F42GZ5K, seed fabro-b959). Fix idea: for fixture literals, use line-addressed sed (e.g. `Ns/old/new/`) or edit_file with unique context instead of pattern-wide sed; the same rule the implementer prompt already states for repetitive rewrites cuts both ways when the pattern is too common.

observations: Reproduction detour worth noting: `replace` to a nonexistent environment fails with a bare SQLite FK error (code 787) rather than a validation error at the store layer — the handler path validates first via `resolve_automation_environment`, but any direct store caller (tests, future code paths) gets an opaque Db error. Not fixed (out of scope), just observed.
